title: Effect of boron addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties of refractory Al0.1CrNbVMo high-entropy alloy
process_method_2: high-energy ball milling + spark plasma sintering
process_description: prepared by high-energy ball milling of elemental powders (Al, Cr, Nb, Mo, V, B) at 200 rpm for 12 h in Ar atmosphere, followed by spark plasma sintering at 1200°C and 50 MPa under vacuum with a heating rate of 100°C/min from 600°C to 1200°C and 5 min holding time.
